AUTHORITATIVE CURRENT-HEAD packet for V3 spatial-runtime hardening before Finder/Inspect product implementation. Fetch the latest remote migration/svelte-go-live-candidate head first. Expected dispatch head is 277701bd99fe18bf45e6f574938263183ff6484e; if the remote has advanced, use the actual current head and preserve newer work. Do not reset, rebase, force-push, or rewrite unrelated history. This packet is narrowly scoped: do NOT implement Finder, Inspect product UI, map visual design, deployment, database/schema changes, DNS, secrets, or Contabo mutation.

1) Fix the verified WebGPU resize bug in apps/web/src/lib/spatial/lifecycle.ts. Current runtime calls session.resize(viewport) then session.render() synchronously. A live WebGPU Chromium audit reproduced GPUValidationError because engine.setSize invalidates/reconfigures the swapchain before the synchronous frame submission. Fix structurally: defer post-resize render until the next animation frame; coalesce repeated resize requests; never render after dispose; cancel pending animation-frame work on dispose/failure; preserve deterministic WebGL2 behaviour and initial startup rendering; update focused lifecycle tests to prove asynchronous/coalesced behaviour. Do not suppress browser diagnostics.

2) Establish the minimum renderer-neutral RuntimeCommand/RuntimeEvent bridge needed for upcoming Finder/Inspect work. Existing Stage 27 contracts already declare LOAD_SCENE, PATCH_CONTRIBUTION, SET_CAMERA, FLY_TO, PICK, RESIZE, REBUILD_RESOURCES and events READY, CAMERA_CHANGED, TARGET_PICKED, TRANSITION_FINISHED, RESOURCE_LOST, RECOVERED, METRICS, while SpatialRuntime currently exposes only status/start/resize/dispose. Add a coherent runtime command/event interface so Svelte communicates with Babylon only through renderer-neutral contracts. No Babylon types may cross spatial/contracts.ts; Svelte components must not call Babylon APIs directly. Preserve current lifecycle API compatibility where reasonable. RESIZE must use the hardened resize path. Emit READY from successful startup rather than duplicating readiness truth. Add deterministic event subscribe/unsubscribe cleanup. Wire reliable Babylon/WebGPU/WebGL2 resource-loss/recovery signals where available. Unsupported future commands may fail closed or remain explicitly unimplemented, but must not silently pretend to execute. Do not invent product map behaviour or visual design.

3) Preserve all accepted foundation work: generated Hey API SDK -> handwritten application facade architecture; lossless Id64; WP0/WP1/WP2 consolidation; packages/api-client; packages/planner-core; modular Babylon isolation; WebGPU preference plus deterministic WebGL2 fallback; Product E2E/Review Lab separation; immutable release/preflight safeguards; Python 3.14 release target. Do not spend time repairing the retained React Review Lab in this pass.

Read CLAUDE.md, docs/development/v3-application-stack-decision.md, docs/development/v3-browser-validation-lanes.md, docs/development/v3-coordination-control-plane.md, docs/colonisation-redesign/spatial-platform-architecture-decision.md, and current apps/web spatial code before editing.

Validation minimum: git diff --check; apps/web typecheck/check; lint; format check; unit tests; build; focused spatial lifecycle/runtime tests; shared package checks if touched; relevant repository spatial-boundary contracts. If a real WebGPU Chromium environment is available, reproduce resize before the fix and verify no GPUValidationError after. No deploy.

Final report must include exact final SHA, resize implementation details, command/event boundary implemented, resource-loss/recovery handling added or explicitly deferred with reason, tests/checks and results, confirmation that Finder/Inspect product work can begin without direct Babylon calls from Svelte, and genuine remaining blockers only.
